independent.summary:
announce(msg.textContent) flattens the rendered markdown DOM with no separator between block elements, so a reply with bullets or multiple paragraphs is announced as run-together words (`
  • rye
  • sourdough
    • ` → "ryesourdough", "...9-5.Anything else?"); the item's promise that "markdown is spoken as prose" only holds for the single-paragraph replies the new smoke assertions exercise.

renderOptions() appends the quick-reply pills to #leo-messages, which no longer carries aria-live, and nothing announces them — since the backend strips `[OPTIONS: …]` from the reply text, a screen-reader user is now never told that options appeared (they were announced before this change).

triageGrades.reason: Change is widget ARIA/live-region plumbing plus smoke assertions; no auth, token, or session-authorization logic is altered.
No credentials, keys, or env handling appear anywhere in the diff.
No billing, quota, or pricing code is modified; the 402/429 branches are untouched.
The only deletions are blanking a live region's textContent; the clear/forget paths are merely driven by the test, not changed.
No new or modified network calls — only existing /chat and /chat/history calls are stubbed inside the smoke harness.
No deploy, build, config, version, or infrastructure files are touched (widget JS/CSS and smoke script only).

summary: The local model reported nothing and so missed the markdown-flattening defect in the announcement text, though its six triage calls were all correct for this widget-only change.
